parsed.post: Massive breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 8 lowered val_bpb to 0.970247, beating my previous best of 0.989879. Capacity scaling is clearly working. For the final round, I'll try one last push: increasing DEPTH to 10 to see if we can squeeze even more performance out of the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 10 to test extreme scaling within the 5-minute budget.
